zero_transfer_selection: Safe for all signed transfer estimators: weights identically zero before/after every continuation; no warning-conditioned selection.
hook_counter_contract: Installed Pythia8 UserHooks.h says counters are emitted ISR/FSR counts so far for hard interaction; maximum checked below100000 hook limit, MPI/decays disabled.
caveats: Controls are independent diagnostic continuation streams, not bitwise replay of original production.
Turning ISR/FSR off changes competition and subsequent kinematics; mode changes are not additive per-component decompositions.
full_without_warned is an outcome-conditioned subset, not an unbiased warning-free control; native logged-warning coverage does not certify silent trial envelopes.
The same-alpha control also changes the subsequent resolved shower; it tests whether the coupling difference alone explains the drift, not a matched source retuning.
